verdict.rationale: Make documents an official MCP server that turns active and on-demand scenarios into callable tools for external MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT, with both scenario-run and management tools. This directly delivers exposing workflows as agent-callable MCP tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed docs on tool schema and setup, and evidence that individual connected-app actions can be exposed directly rather than only through scenarios.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call

citations.quote: Turns your **active** and **on-demand** scenarios into callable tools for AI
AI systems like Claude and ChatGPT act as MCP clients of Make MCP server. The server provides them access to **scenario run** and **management** tools
Make MCP server allows AI systems, such as large language models (LLMs), to run scenarios and manage the contents of your Make account.
